arxiv-2011-11845.title: Classification of coadjoint orbits for symplectomorphism groups of surfaces
arxiv-2011-11845.creator: Ilia Kirillov
arxiv-2011-11845.description:
A 2020 arXiv research paper by Ilia Kirillov. We classify generic coadjoint orbits for symplectomorphism groups of compact symplectic surfaces with or without boundary. We also classify simple Morse functions on such surfaces up to a symplectomorphism. 1
Introduction

The classification problem for coadjoint orbits for the action of symplectic (or area-preserving) diffeomorphisms in two dimensions was known to specialists in view of its application in fluid dynamics since the 1960s, and it was explicitly formulated in

arxiv-2012-12546.title: Manifold Reconstruction and Denoising from Scattered Data in High Dimension via a Generalization of L 1 L_{1} -Median
arxiv-2012-12546.creator: Shira Faigenbaum-Golovin David Levin
arxiv-2012-12546.description: Abstract In this paper, we present a method for denoising and reconstruction of low-dimensional manifold in high-dimensional space. We suggest a multidimensional extension of the Locally Optimal Projection algorithm which was introduced by Lipman et al. in 2007 for surface reconstruction in 3D. The method bypasses the curse of dimensionality and avoids the need for carrying out dimensional reduction.

arxiv-2210-05825.title: Controllable Radiance Fields for Dynamic Face Synthesis
arxiv-2210-05825.creator: Peiye Zhuang 1 {1}, Liqian Ma 2 {2}, Sanmi Koyejo 1 , 3 , 4 {1,3,4}, Alexander Schwing 1 {1}
arxiv-2210-05825.description: Abstract Recent work on 3D-aware image synthesis has achieved compelling results using advances in neural rendering. However, 3D-aware synthesis of face dynamics hasn’t received much attention. Here, we study how to explicitly control generative model synthesis of face dynamics exhibiting non-rigid motion (e.g., facial expression change), while simultaneously ensuring 3D-awareness.

arxiv-2501-15256.title: Three-dimensional core-collapse supernova models with phenomenological treatment of neutrino flavor conversions
arxiv-2501-15256.creator: Kanji Mori, Tomoya Takiwaki, Kei Kotake, and Shunsaku Horiuchi
arxiv-2501-15256.description: Abstract We perform three-dimensional supernova simulations with a phenomenological treatment of neutrino flavor conversions. We show that the explosion energy can increase to as high as ∼ 10 51 \sim 10^{51} erg depending on the critical density for the onset of flavor conversions, due to a significant enhancement of the mean energy of electron antineutrinos.

arxiv-2504-07319.title: GPR_calculator: An On-the-Fly Surrogate Model to Accelerate Massive Nudged Elastic Band Calculations
arxiv-2504-07319.creator: Isaac Onyango, Byungkyun Kang, Qiang Zhu
arxiv-2504-07319.description: Abstract We present GPR_calculator , a package based on Python and C++ programming languages to build an on-the-fly surrogate model using Gaussian Process Regression (GPR) to approximate computationally expensive electronic structure calculations. The key idea is to dynamically train a GPR model during the simulation that can accurately predict energies and forces with uncertainty quantification.

arxiv-2507-23628.title: Characterizing the Kirkwood-Dirac positivity on second countable LCA groups
arxiv-2507-23628.creator: Matéo Spriet
arxiv-2507-23628.description: Abstract We define the Kirkwood-Dirac quasiprobability representation of quantum mechanics associated with the Fourier transform over second countable locally compact abelian groups. We discuss its link with the Kohn-Nirenberg quantization of the phase space G × G ^ G\times\widehat{G} .

plos-pone-0011858.description: PLOS ONE research article. Malignant peripheral nerve sheath tumors (MPNST) are highly aggressive tumors which originate from Schwann cells and develop in about 10% of neurofibromatosis type 1 (NF1) patients. The five year survival rate is poor and more effective therapies are needed. Sunitinib is a drug t

pmc-10541687.title: Comparing the antidepressant-like effects of electroconvulsive seizures in adolescent and adult female rats: an intensity dose–response study
pmc-10541687.creator: Sandra Ledesma-Corvi, M Julia García-Fuster
pmc-10541687.description: A peer-reviewed research article from Europe PMC (2023). BackgroundThe induction of electroconvulsive seizures (ECS) in rodents induces sex- and age-specific disparities in antidepressant-like responses, with females and young age being the most unresponsive ones. Since the electrical charge needed to induce an effective convulsion is also altered by these variables, our aim was to compare different dose-intensities of ECS exclusively in female rats, since there is a lack of preclinical data characterizing this particular sex, while also evaluating efficacy during distinctive age periods of treatment (adolescence vs.

pmc-10826702.title: Efficient production and characterization of melanin from Thermothelomyces hinnuleus SP1, isolated from the coal mines of Chhattisgarh, India
pmc-10826702.creator: Shalini Pandey, Vineet Meshram, Hany M. Yehia, Abdulhakeem Alzahrani, Nadeem Akhtar, Arunima Sur
pmc-10826702.description: In the present study, fungi were isolated and screened from barren land in south-eastern Coalfields limited (SECL) in Chhattisgarh, India. Out of 14 isolated fungi, only three fungal isolates exhibited pigmentation in screening studies. The isolated fungal strain SP1 exhibited the highest pigmentation, which was further utilized for in vivo production, purification, and characterization of melanin pigment.

pmc-10852352.title: Conformational Changes and ATP Hydrolysis in Zika Helicase: The Molecular Basis of a Biomolecular Motor Unveiled by Multiscale Simulations
pmc-10852352.creator: Adrián García-Martínez, Kirill Zinovjev, José Javier Ruiz-Pernía, Iñaki Tuñón
pmc-10852352.description: We computationally study the Zika NS3 helicase, a biological motor, using ATP hydrolysis energy for nucleic acid remodeling. Through molecular mechanics and hybrid quantum mechanics/molecular mechanics simulations, we explore the conformational landscape of motif V, a conserved loop connecting the active sites for ATP hydrolysis and nucleic acid binding.

pmc-11411903.title: Beliefs of Moroccan patients with chronic inflammatory rheumatic diseases regarding medication: related factors and correlation with therapeutic adherence
pmc-11411903.creator: Fatima Zahrae Taik, Noema El Mansouri, Rajaa Bensaid, Anass Adnine, Amine Amar, Maryam Fourtassi, Fatima Ezzahra Abourazzak
pmc-11411903.description: BackgroundMedication adherence is one of the key elements of the management of patients with chronic inflammatory rheumatic diseases (CIRDs), adherence/medication regimes are prone to being influenced by beliefs about medicines; such beliefs can influence the management and quality of life of patients. Several factors may be associated with these beliefs, including demographic and clinical factors, as well as socio-psychological factors.

pmc-11419301.title: Education Research: Neuroradiology Curriculum and Competencies Among Canadian Adult Neurology Residency Programs
pmc-11419301.creator: Diana Benea, Rose Di Ioia, Julien Bejjani, Anne Xuan-Lan Nguyen, Isabelle Hardy, Isabelle Trop, Nicolas Jodoin
pmc-11419301.description: A peer-reviewed research article from Europe PMC (2023). Background and ObjectivesWhile benefitting from neuroradiologists' reports, neurologists use their own image interpretation to guide clinical decisions, especially in acute care settings. This calls for robust neuroradiology training in neurology residency, informed by current educational gaps and practices.

pmc-11605838.title: Interferon-α as a biomarker to predict renal outcomes in lupus nephritis
pmc-11605838.creator: Laura Patricia Whittall Garcia, Dafna D Gladman, Murray Urowitz, Dennisse Bonilla, Raphael Schneider, Zahi Touma, Joan Wither
pmc-11605838.description: ABSTRACTObjectiveTo determine if serum interferon (IFN)-α levels at the time of a lupus nephritis (LN) flare are associated with renal outcomes.MethodsPatients with an LN flare who had a preflare estimated glomerular filtration rate (eGFR) ≥60 mL/min were included in the study.

pmc-12412246.title: DNA G-quadruplex profiling in skeletal muscle stem cells reveals functional and mechanistic insights
pmc-12412246.creator: Xiaona Chen, Feng Yang, Suyang Zhang, Xiaofan Guo, Jieyu Zhao, Yulong Qiao, Liangqiang He, Yang Li, Qin Zhou, Michael Tim-Yun Ong, Chun Kit Kwok, Hao Sun, Huating Wang
pmc-12412246.description: BackgroundDNA G-quadruplexes (G4s) are non-canonical secondary structures formed in guanine-rich DNA sequences and play important roles in modulating biological processes through a variety of gene regulatory mechanisms. Emerging G4 profiling allows global mapping of endogenous G4 formation.ResultsHere in this study, we map the G4 landscapes in adult skeletal muscle stem cells (MuSCs), which are essential for injury-induced muscle regeneration.

pmc-12427916.title: From Data to Diagnosis: A Novel Deep Learning Model for Early and Accurate Diabetes Prediction
pmc-12427916.creator: Muhammad Mohsin Zafar, Zahoor Ali Khan, Nadeem Javaid, Muhammad Aslam, Nabil Alrajeh, Daniele Giansanti
pmc-12427916.description: Background: Diabetes remains a major global health challenge, contributing significantly to premature mortality due to its potential progression to organ failure if not diagnosed early. Traditional diagnostic approaches are subject to human error, highlighting the need for modern computational techniques in clinical decision support systems.

pmc-12454864.title: A nonlinear, causal link between serum 25-hydroxyvitamin D and prolactin in type 2 diabetes: Evidence from clinical and Mendelian randomization analyses
pmc-12454864.creator: Jing He, Ying-chuan Yin, Wang Zhang, Xiao-hong Shi, Cui-ling Zhu
pmc-12454864.description: BackgroundType 2 diabetes mellitus is increasingly prevalent and often accompanied by vitamin D insufficiency. Prolactin, once considered solely lactogenic, has emerged as a metabolic regulator, yet its relationship with vitamin D in T2DM remains unclear.MethodsWe conducted a cross-sectional study of 221 male T2DM patients aged 25–75 years recruited between January 2022 and December 2024.

pmc-12473728.title: Rare Mimic of Conjunctivitis: Conjunctival Intraepithelial Sebaceous Carcinoma
pmc-12473728.creator: Maedot A. Haymete, Kristen Delans, Paul Varghese, Nicholas Ramey, Douglas J. Grider
pmc-12473728.description: Sebaceous carcinoma, an uncommon malignant neoplasm, often arises de novo from periocular sebaceous glands. Commonly manifesting as diffuse eyelid thickening, sebaceous carcinoma can mimic other inflammatory processes such as persistent chalazion or blepharitis. Delayed diagnosis often complicates the disease course due to its indolent presentation.

pmc-12529625.title: Building analytical capacity for research at Federally Qualified Health Centers through the All of Us Research Program
pmc-12529625.creator: Soumya Kini, Derek Inokuchi, Jessica Burke, Jennifer Adjemian, Andrea Ramirez, Edgar A. Diaz, Grace Wang, Sarra Hedden
pmc-12529625.description: A peer-reviewed research article from Europe PMC (2025). The National Institutes of Health All of Us Research Program (All of Us or program) aims to better understand the complexity of diseases, prevention and treatment at the individual level. To accomplish this, one of the program components is to build a longitudinal cohort of one million or more volunteers in the United States and its territories through which clinical, environmental, genetic, and behavioral data are collected.

pmc-12556164.title: Building trust and fostering collaboration for equitable access to medicines in North Macedonia
pmc-12556164.creator: P Vracko, E Aragon de Leon
pmc-12556164.description: Under Phase IV of the UHC Partnership, North Macedonia focused on strengthening health system governance and health policy development, with key investments in institutional capacity, health workforce planning, primary health care (PHC), sustainable health financing, and access to medicines. Efforts included training Ministry of Health professionals in policy analysis, strategic planning, and evidence-based decision-making while enhancing coordination and policy coherence.

pmc-12988758.title: Efficacy and Safety of Nanoparticle Albumin-Bound Paclitaxel Compared to Docetaxel Plus Nedaplatin as Induction Chemotherapy for Locally Advanced Nasopharyngeal Carcinoma: A Propensity Score Matching Analysis
pmc-12988758.creator: Quan-Quan Sun, Jing Chen, Zhi-Min Ye, Yong-Hong Hua, Lu-Ying Liu, Tongxin Liu
pmc-12988758.description: PurposeThis study aimed to compare the long-term efficacy and safety of nanoparticle albumin-bound paclitaxel plus nedaplatin (NP) versus docetaxel plus nedaplatin (TP) as induction chemotherapy (IC) for locally advanced nasopharyngeal carcinoma (LA NPC).MethodsIn this retrospective analysis, treatment-naïve patients with stage III–IVa NPC who received IC with either NP or TP regimen between December 2018 and January 2021 were enrolled.

pmc-12997804.title: Soil microbial and plant responses to increasing antibiotic concentration: a case study of five antibiotics
pmc-12997804.creator: Sarah van den Broek, Inna Nybom, Rafaela Feola Conz, Yifei Sun, Thomas D. Bucheli, Sebastian Doetterl, Martin Hartmann, Gina Garland
pmc-12997804.description: Antibiotic contamination from biogenic waste in agricultural soils poses a significant threat to soil health and crop productivity. We investigated the effect of antibiotics on the soil microbial community, antibiotic resistance genes, and mobile genetic elements (MGEs) and plant productivity in a 6-week greenhouse trial.

pmc-13049009.title: Design of a multi-layered privacy-preserving architecture for secure medical data exchange in cloud environments
pmc-13049009.creator: S Muthuvel, S Priya, K Sampath Kumar
pmc-13049009.description: Cloud-based e-health systems make medical data widely accessible for treatment, teleconsultation, and analytics; however, the moment clinical records are pushed to an external cloud, they are exposed to a combination of threats: curious insiders, colluding storage providers, and silent data tampering. Most existing attribute-based encryption (ABE) or standalone anomaly detection solutions address these threats in isolation.

pmc-13076678.title: New predicted dual CDK-2/CDK-1 inhibitors from Aspergillus unguis isolate SP51-EGY with relative selectivity for colorectal cancer cells: a computational and experimental approach
pmc-13076678.creator: Ahmed A El-Rashedy, Amal Mosad Ibrahim, Mohamed S Abdel-Aziz, Walid Fayad, Faten K Abd EL-Hady
pmc-13076678.description: Colorectal cancer is one of the deadliest cancers in the world. The main problem with cancer treatments is that they need to protect healthy cells. Cyclin-dependent kinases (CDKs), especially CDK-2 and CDK-1, are essential for regulating the cell cycle, cell growth, and tumor genesis.

pmc-13300645.title: The Potential Role of Vitamin D in BRCA1 Pathogenic Variant Carriers: A Narrative Review
pmc-13300645.creator: Joanna Robaczyńska, Milena Kiljańczyk, Maciej Maj, Adam Kiljańczyk, Tomasz Byrski, Cezary Cybulski, Izabela Janiuk, Jacek Gronwald, Jan Lubiński

pmc-13479828.title: A quorum sensing antagonist with dual bacterium- and host-directed anti-pathogenic activity against Pseudomonas aeruginosa
pmc-13479828.creator: Dan-Dan Li, Huiyan Li, Wen-Xin Niu, Huayue Li, Joon-Hee Lee
pmc-13479828.description: Pseudomonas aeruginosa is a major opportunistic pathogen whose clinical management is increasingly compromised by antibiotic resistance and biofilm-associated persistence. Anti-pathogenic strategies that attenuate virulence without inhibiting bacterial growth offer a promising alternative to conventional antibiotics. Here, we identify the Spongosorites sp-derived bisindole alkaloid (R)-6’-debromohamacanthin B (RDB) as a potent dual bacterium- and host-directed anti-pathogenic agent against P. aeruginosa.

pmc-13522540.title: Fast-growing intracellular Mycobacterium tuberculosis populations evade antibiotic treatment
pmc-13522540.creator: Nathan J. Day, Baptiste Pradel, Chak Hon Luk, Pierre Santucci, Antony Fearns, Angela Rodgers, Beren Aylan, Laure Botella, Julien Vaubourgeix, Julio Ortiz Canseco, Natalia Athanasiadi, Maximiliano G. Gutierrez

schiller-camp-wallenstein-1798.title: Wallensteins Lager
schiller-camp-wallenstein-1798.creator: Friedrich Schiller
schiller-camp-wallenstein-1798.description: The prologue of the Wallenstein trilogy, in the original German — the soldiers' camp before the fall. Staged in German to complete the trilogy; no PD English standalone exists. [Translation: German original (no PD English standalone; Churchill's translation exists only in Bohn's complete Works).]
